U. (रिणाक्ति, रिङ्क्ते, रिक्त) 
__1 To empty, evacuate, clear, purge; रिणच्मि जलधेस्तोयम् [[

.]] 
__2 To deprive of, make destitute of. 
__3 To separate, divide. 
__4 To give or deliver up, part with. 
__5 To bequeath (usually in p. p., see रिक्त).

P. (रेचति, रेचयति, रेचित) 
__1 To divide, separate, disjoin. 
__2 To abandon, leave. 
__3 To join, mix. -Caus. 
__1 To evacuate, make empty. 
__2 To discharge, emit (as breath). 
__3 To leave, abandon.
